title: Every captured width matches: 1040, 1280, 1600 (oracle-main-*)
evidence: Every frame case passes at every captured width. The composer is the main column less 16 each side, up to 960 (#3). The 1280 capture had held a hovered Composer actions; recaptured 2026-11-09 with the pointer parked (sweep park()), it reads like the other widths. Edges measured on the oracle (2026-11-09): below 800 Shell closes the panel itself and leaves it closed on widening (790 closed, 800 open); the 720 and 790 scenes start open so the rule does the closing. From 800 to 840 the column holds at 424 and the panel gives way (min(320, width - 88 - 424)), its content reflowing. A column under 592 shows Share as its 36 pt icon (572 icon, 592 label).
